agent_answered.text: ClearedIndex answered from its published manifest: 4224 listings, protocols x402/mpp/l402, primary resource /api/x402/ping at $0.001 USDC on Base with EIP-3009 settlement and an X-Settlement-Tx path. Its own skill.md states its job is to "Witness settlement before USDC moves" - the asset is baked into the job description, not a configurable field. So ClearedIndex is a trust/attestation gateway whose rail is USDC by definition; there is no accepts[] for an operator to add Nano to. Measured, not guessed.
